description_en: Queries the cloud recording files and task information for RTC
description_zh: 查询rtc云端录制文件与任务信息
name: DescribeRtcCloudRecordingFiles

parameters.help_en: The task ID. This ID is returned by StartRtcCloudRecording. Only tasks created within the last 3 days can be queried
parameters.help_zh: 任务id。由StartRtcCloudRecording返回，只支持查询创建时间在3天内的任务
parameters.name: task_id

HlsFileList.description_en: The array of HLS recording file names

Mp3FileList.description_en: The array of MP3 recording file names

Mp4FileList.description_en: The array of MP4 recording file names

VodMediaList.description_en: The array of VOD media resources. When recording to VOD, this is the collection of recording files for each subscribed stream, where each item corresponds to a subscribed stream
VodMediaList.description_zh: VOD媒体资源数组。录制到VOD时，订阅的各个流的录制文件集合，其中每一项对应着一个订阅流

items.description_en: The media resource information for a subscribed stream
items.description_zh: 对应订阅的某条流的媒体资源信息

MediaIds.description_en: The array of media resource IDs generated during recording
MediaIds.description_zh: 录制过程中生成的媒体资源id数组

items.description_en: The media resource ID generated during recording
items.description_zh: 录制过程中生成的媒体资源id

MergedIds.description_en: The array of automatically merged media resource IDs generated after recording ends
MergedIds.description_zh: 录制结束后生成的自动合并的媒体资源id数组

items.description_en: The automatically merged media resource ID generated after recording ends
items.description_zh: 录制结束后生成的自动合并的媒体资源id

Stream.description_en:
The subscribed stream.
For stream mixing recording, the value is always Mix.
For single-stream recording, the value is Single::{UserId}::{Suffix}.
UserId is the UserId corresponding to this stream.
Suffix depends on the StreamType and SourceType specified during subscription.
     - When StreamType is 0: if SourceType is 0, Suffix is AV::C. If SourceType is 1, Suffix is AV::S.
     - When StreamType is 1: Suffix can only be A.
     - When StreamType is 2 (not supported for single-stream recording): if SourceType is 0, Suffix is V::C. If SourceType is 1, Suffix is V::S
Stream.description_zh:
表示订阅的流
对于混流录制，值统一为Mix
对于单流录制，值为Single::{UserId}::{Suffix}
UserId为这条流对应的UserId
Suffix与订阅时填写的StreamType和SourceType有关
     - 当StreamType为0时：如果SourceType为0，那么Suffix为AV::C；如果SourceType为1，那么Suffix为AV::S
     - 当StreamType为1时：Suffix只能为A
     - 当StreamType为2时（单流录制暂不支持）：如果SourceType为0，那么Suffix为V::C；如果SourceType为1，那么Suffix为V::S

Status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:
RUNNING
RECOVERING
STOPPING
STOPPED
Status.description_zh:
任务状态：
RUNNING
RECOVERING
STOPPING
STOPPED

TaskId.description_en: The task ID passed in the request
